metrics.cloud_pct_source: OPERA DSWx-HLS cloud class (WTR 253) 2025-12-15/17 over the AOI
metrics.hls_method: all water, OPERA DSWx-HLS (optical) 2025-12-15/17, cloud-free pixels only; 92.9% cloud -> reference mostly unobserved; not comparable to iou/f1
metrics.validation_method: like-for-like: NISAR new-flood mask vs OPERA DSWx-S1 new flood (water on 2025-12-15/17 AND NOT water 2025-12-01..07), cloud-free on both dates; NISAR swath ~ AOI
metrics.validation_method_raw: all water: NISAR flood mask vs every OPERA DSWx-S1 water pixel 2025-12-15/17 over the AOI (includes permanent/pre-existing water, so FN is inflated)
metrics.validation_area_note: confusion/confusion_raw/hls_confusion are OPERA DSWx pixel counts on the 0.0002694933 deg/px EE reduceRegion lattice (30 m nominal); in EPSG:4326 at the wa_2025 AOI-mean latitude 47.75 N one lattice pixel is ~600 m2 geodesic (0.000600 km2), NOT 900 m2 — *_km2 companions = px x geodesic pixel area at the AOI-mean latitude. data/wa_2025/opera_validation.json legend km2 is already per-row geodesic (~598 m2 effective). IoU/F1/precision/recall are ratios of counts and are unchanged.
